snippet.title: Winter Wonderland - Serious Sam Fusion Campaign - Teaser
snippet.description:
Here's something we've started while ago and i'm proud to announce we are nearly done. Firstly it was inspired from an SSX Cutscene but then it turned into it's own thing.

Winter Wonderland is a Serious Sam Fusion HD TSE 3-levels campaign with big variety featuring new soundtracks as well, creds to @Musearys besides the tracks she put hard work on she also assisted with some concepts and ideas around. Gotta say she's being a big motivation since we started and i'm glad to see she stayed till the end ! ❤️

ETA is planned to be Around Jan-Feb but as we know plans may change ™
